_about: Small fact bank for the fee explainer. Every fact was read from the official Groww pages listed in sources on the date in last_checked. The explainer is built only from entries in this file; the model may reword or reorder them but code rejects any number that is not in the entry.

help_dp.title: Groww Help: When are DP charges levied?

help_charges.title: Groww Help: How much does Groww charge for stocks?

brokerage.name: Brokerage
facts: Groww's equity brokerage is ₹20 or 0.1% of the order value, whichever is lower, with a minimum of ₹5 per executed order.
The charge applies per executed order, so a buy order and a sell order are separate orders.
18% GST applies on brokerage.
Regulatory and statutory charges are listed separately from brokerage on the pricing page, and the help page says they are levied by the exchange, not by Groww.
Delivery sell transactions also carry a separate DP charge, which is not part of brokerage.

dp_charges.name: DP charges on selling shares
facts: DP (depository participant) charges are triggered when shares leave the demat account, which happens on sales, and are calculated per sell transaction.
Intraday DP charges are ₹0; the charge applies to delivery sells.
The charge has two parts: ₹16.50 charged by Groww and ₹3.50 charged by the depository, or ₹3.25 for women.
Groww's ₹16.50 part is not charged when the debit value is under ₹100; the depository part still applies.
18% GST applies on DP charges.
The charge is a fixed rupee amount per sell transaction, not a percentage of the sale value.

auto_square_off.name: Auto square-off charge
facts: Groww lists an auto square-off charge of ₹50 per position for open intraday positions that the system squares off.
18% GST applies on auto square-off charges.

mtf_interest.name: MTF interest and brokerage
facts: Interest on Margin Trading Facility (MTF) funding is 14.95% per annum on the funded amount.
MTF brokerage is separate: 0.1% of the order value per order.

gst_taxes.name: GST, STT and other statutory charges
facts: 18% GST applies on brokerage, DP charges, exchange transaction charges, SEBI turnover charges, delayed payment charges and auto square-off charges.
Securities Transaction Tax (STT) is 0.1% on both buy and sell for delivery orders, and 0.025% on sell orders for intraday.
Stamp duty is 0.015% on buy orders for delivery and 0.003% on buy orders for intraday.
The SEBI turnover charge is 0.0001% on both buy and sell.
The help page states that regulatory and statutory fees are levied by the exchange, not by Groww.

overall_charges.name: Charges deducted on a trade
facts: Brokerage is ₹20 or 0.1% of the order value, whichever is lower, with a minimum of ₹5 per executed order.
Selling shares from the demat account also attracts a DP charge: ₹16.50 charged by Groww (not charged when the debit value is under ₹100) plus ₹3.50 charged by the depository.
18% GST applies on brokerage and DP charges.
Regulatory and statutory charges such as STT, stamp duty and SEBI turnover fees are listed separately on the pricing page.
Intraday orders carry no DP charge.

_unresolved: Groww's pricing page says DP charges are 'per sell transaction' but does not say whether that means per order or per stock; the explainer says 'per sell transaction' and does not go further.
The BSE exchange transaction rate differs between two sections of the pricing page, so no exchange transaction rate is quoted.
